Authorization
Before using the API, you'll need to set up authorization. To quickly get started, refer to our Setup Guide.
Create a token
Permanent link: Create a token

Expects two headers:

Authorization header formed from base-64 encoded client credentials as Authorization: Basic <base64-encoded client_id:client_secret>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

Required content body depends on authorization type method, as defined by grant_type.

Authorization Code Grant (grant_type=authorization_code): grant_type, code, and redirect_uri are required. Request must happen after requested scopes have been approved and exchanged for authorization code.
Refresh Token Grant (grant_type=refresh_token): grant_type and refresh_token are required. User must have previously obtained refresh token in authorization code flow.
Client Credentials Grant (grant_type=client_credentials): grant_type is required. If scope is omitted, the access token has no scopes.
Request body
grant_type
string

Grant type, must be one of: ['authorization_code', 'client_credentials', 'refresh_token']. Refresh token and client credentials grants must be added to app's permitted Grant Types.

 Allowed values 

code
string
optional

Authorization code obtained from request to https://app.ramp.com/v1/authorize, to be exchanged for access token. Field is required if grant_type=authorization_code.

redirect_uri
string
optional

The redirect URI previously used in the authorization request, used to verify app. Field is required if grant_type=authorization_code.

refresh_token
string
optional

The refresh token issued to you to get a new access token.

scope
string
optional

Space-separated list of scopes to be granted to the returned token. These must be a subset (including full set) of the app's allowed scopes. If omitted for grant_type=client_credentials, the returned token has no scopes.

Response 
HTTP 200
access_token
string
optional

The access token string. Prefixed with ramp_business_tok_, ramp_user_tok_, ramp_business_jwt_, or ramp_user_jwt_.

expires_in
integer
optional

The duration of which the token is valid, measured in seconds.

id_token
string
optional

An OpenID Connect ID token.

refresh_token
string
optional

Refresh token can be used to get a new access token. Note that refresh token won't appear in the response for client_credentials grant type. Prefixed with ramp_business_tok_ or ramp_user_tok_.

refresh_token_expires_in
integer or null
optional

The duration of which the refresh token is valid, measured in seconds. This field only appears for clients configured with a refresh token TTL and only when a refresh token is returned.

scope
string
optional

Space-separated list of scopes of the access token.

token_type
string
optional

The type of the token. This should always be 'Bearer'.

Was this section useful?

POST
/developer/v1/token
Shell 
Copy
curl --location --request POST "https://api.ramp.com/developer/v1/token" \
    -H "Authorization: Basic <base-64-encoded client_id:client_secret>" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
    --data-urlencode "code=wUvTfJmrDiTogz3dRNsUJdBRtSl658ibsH8xLKwKQ2PbttRr" \
		--data-urlencode "grant_type=authorization_code" \
		--data-urlencode "redirect_uri=https://www.yourawesomeapp.com" \
		--data-urlencode "refresh_token=ramp_business_tok_IwOGYzYTlmM2YxOTQ5MGE3YmNmMDFkNTVk" \
		--data-urlencode "scope=users:read users:write"

Revoke an access or refresh token
Permanent link: Revoke an access or refresh token

Expects an authorization header formed from base-64 encoded client credentials as Authorization: Basic <base64-encoded client_id:client_secret>.

Content body must be form-encoded. Example:

curl \
    -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: Basic <base64-encoded client_id:client_secret>" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
    --data-urlencode 'token=$RAMP_API_TOKEN' \
    'https://api.ramp.com/developer/v1/token/revoke'
Request body
token
string

Access token or refresh token to be revoked.

token_type_hint
string
optional

Type of the token to be revoked.

 Allowed values 

Response 
HTTP 200

No output schema defined.

Was this section useful?

POST
/developer/v1/token/revoke
Shell 
Copy
curl --location --request POST "https://api.ramp.com/developer/v1/token/revoke" \
    -H "Authorization: Basic <base-64-encoded client_id:client_secret>" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
    --data-urlencode "token=ramp_business_tok_IwOGYzYTlmM2YxOTQ5MGE3YmNmMDFkNTVk" \
		--data-urlencode "token_type_hint=refresh_token"
